subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Dark Stores
description: A short lesson to help you apply Dark Stores.

hook.text: It looks like a grocery store, but no customers walk in. Workers rush through aisles filling online orders.

buildup.text: Dark stores are retail locations converted to fulfillment centers—open only for order packing, not shoppers.

discovery.text: They're positioned in urban areas for faster delivery, using existing retail space for e-commerce.

twist.text: They sacrifice walk-in revenue. If online volume drops, the space sits idle with no foot traffic to fall back on.

climax.text: Grocery chains use dark stores to offer 15-minute delivery in dense cities—speed that regular stores can't match.

punchline.text: No shoppers inside. Just pickers racing against the clock.

quiz.question: What is a dark store?
options: A retail space used only for fulfilling online orders
